items.name: Poly Cubed at Pomona 2025
items.information: The incredible sequel to 2018's hit competition, Poly^3 @ Pomona 2025 will have more competitors, more cubes, and more fun! This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PolyCubedatPomona2025/#64691-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. All attendees under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a parent/guardian. This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdDlaIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c9aec1f797e8f637a46252ccaa3631e415914c78/newwcomer-month.jpg) ​ ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc2hiIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4e3eff62ae7d9d9a76dea175436b619568f5b8f2/EN.png) This competition is being organized by the Rubik klub Slovenija. If you need any additional information, or if you would like to change your registration, please write an e-mail to the **wca.slovenia@gmail.com**. This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024. **The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors.** New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. ##### Registrations will be accepted based on the following: - 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. - Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. - If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. - If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. For more information, please check the tabs! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc2xiIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6e4ca2771e9de59b2b4ec158347f69fed9d1d546/SI.png) Tekmovanje organizira Rubik klub Slovenija. Če potrebujete dodatne informacije ali če bi želeli spremeniti svojo prijavo, nam pišite na **wca.slovenia@gmail.com**. To tekmovanje je vključeno v uraden WCA mesec novincev 2024. **Pri prijavah je 50% mest rezerviranih za novince.** Za novince se štejejo tisti tekmovalci, ki so še brez WCA ID-ja ali imajo WCA ID z začetkom 2024. Za povratnike se štejejo tisti tekmovalci, ki imajo WCA ID iz leta 2023 ali prej. Vsi tekmovalci morajo še vedno upoštevati vse zahteve za prijavo, da se njihova prijava šteje za popolno. ##### Prijave bodo sprejete na naslednji način: - 50% mest določenih z omejitvijo tekmovalcev je rezerviranih za novince. - Na začetku je 50% mest določenih z omejitvijo tekmovalcev na voljo za povratnike. Prijave bodo sprejete po običajnem redu - po vrstnem redu, kot bodo izpolnjeni vsi pogoji. - Če se prijavi več kot 50% novincev preden se zapolni preostalih 50% mest s povratniki, se nadaljnje prijave sprejemajo po običajnem redu za novince in povratnike hkrati. - Če novinci ne zapolnijo rezerviranih mest pred koncem prijav, dva tedna pred tekmovanjem, bodo preostala mesta zapolnjena s povratniki na čakalni listi do zapolnitve mest. Za več informacij preverite zavihke!

items.name: Ponte Tresamateurs 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjAzODksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--9f4703bb8694974000e48f846fd2d76ffa28f318/newcomer.jpg) [IT] Si tratta di una gara adatta ai principianti! Tutti sono i benvenuti, ma se non avete mai gareggiato prima d'ora, questa è la gara a cui iscriversi! Questa gara fa parte del WCA Newcomer Month 2025. Il processo di iscrizione riserverà il 50% dei posti ai nuovi concorrenti. Per nuovi concorrenti si intende che non hanno un ID WCA o un ID WCA del 2025. I concorrenti che ritornano sono considerati in possesso di un ID WCA del 2024 o precedente. Tutti i concorrenti devono comunque rispettare tutti i requisiti di registrazione affinché la loro iscrizione sia considerata completa. Le iscrizioni saranno accettate in base a quanto segue: Il 50% dei posti, come definito dal limite dei concorrenti, è riservato ai nuovi concorrenti. Inizialmente, il 50% dei posti, come definito dal limite dei concorrenti, è disponibile per i concorrenti che ritornano, in base all'ordine di arrivo. Se più del 50% dei nuovi concorrenti si iscrive prima che il 50% dei posti sia occupato dai concorrenti che ritornano, ogni ulteriore nuovo concorrente sarà accettato in base all'ordine di arrivo, insieme ai concorrenti che ritornano. Se i posti riservati ai nuovi concorrenti non vengono occupati da nuovi concorrenti prima della chiusura delle iscrizioni due settimane prima della gara, i posti rimanenti, fino al limite dei concorrenti, saranno accettati dai concorrenti già iscritti. Questa gara è una competizione in serie con **Show Your Skills in Ponte Tresa 2025**. È possibile iscriversi e partecipare a una sola di queste gare. [EN] This is a very beginner-friendly competition! Everyone is welcome but if you have never competed before this is the one to sign up for! This competition is part of the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID from 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. This competition is a series competition with **Show Your Skills in Ponte Tresa 2025**. You may only register for and compete in one of these competitions.

items.information: Popping Off Pukekohe A 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. Please note this is a **twin competition**. To make it fairer and more accessible to more competitiors during the current covid-19 restrictions, you will only be allowed to register for one competition - not both. Please check the event list and timings to see which day you would like to register for as there will be different events on different days ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdHdTIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8ca83de1b84ca1adb1aaa2f8fcd91f0e5d2516dd/PukekoheAWhiteBG.png)

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjE5MTU3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6767acf00e820f8d8610aadf63d58431dcd8b4b9/cubestore%20pre-championship.jpg) **PRE-CHAMPIONSHIP ATHENS 2026** Στις 14 και 15 Νοεμβρίου 2026, όλοι οι Cubers συναντιόμαστε ξανά στο **Panellinios Club House** για έναν ξεχωριστό διήμερο διαγωνισμό γεμάτο ταχύτητα, συναγωνισμό και όμορφες στιγμές. Το **PRE-CHAMPIONSHIP ATHENS 2026** θα αποτελέσει ταυτόχρονα την 3η αγωνιστική της **GREEK CUBING LEAGUE**! Τα μέλη της **GREEK CUBING LEAGUE** ([https://greekcubingleague.gr](https://greekcubingleague.gr)) θα έχουν **επιστροφή 4€** στην κάρτα τους, αμέσως μόλις οριστικοποιηθεί η εγγραφή τους μετά την ημερομηνία που αυτές θα κλείσουν. Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός, που θα διαρκέσει και τις δυο μέρες του Σαββατοκύριακου, αποτελεί το ιδανικό αγωνιστικό warm-up πριν από το μεγάλο γεγονός της χρονιάς, το **Εθνικό μας Πρωτάθλημα**. Είναι η ευκαιρία να δοκιμάσετε τις δυνάμεις σας, να βελτιώσετε τις επιδόσεις σας και να προετοιμαστείτε κατάλληλα για τη μεγάλη διοργάνωση που ακολουθεί. Ετοιμαστείτε για ακόμη ένα αξέχαστο cubing Σαββατοκύριακο! Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε να ζήσουμε μαζί μια ακόμη μεγάλη γιορτή του cubing! items.information: [CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce our first series competition in Joburg. ## SERIES COMPETITION **There will be two competitions happening on Saturday the 25th - you need to choose ONE to sign up for.** * The [Morning Competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PretoriaSpringMorning2023) will only feature 3x3 - we will aim to have 3-4 rounds of 3x3, depending how much time is available. * The Afternoon Competition will feature 3x3, 4x4 and 3x3 one-handed - there will be more strict cutoff/advancement criteria for the Afternoon Competition, in order to fit all the events into the time we have available. ## SPECTATORS Competitors are welcome to bring up to **two** spectators with them. ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ## SPONSORSHIP A big thanks to [Solve-it Puzzles](https://solveitpuzzles.co.za/bestcubesandpuzzles/) who are sponsoring vouchers as a part of the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to try out and buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. #### About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTUxODcwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--62029d0f4d25823b22631d6926f41fe89ef432b9/WhatsApp%20Image%202025-12-26%20at%207.24.06%20PM.jpeg) **Español** ¡Bienvenidos al Pumacubo CDMX 2026! Sé parte de la primera competencia de cubos en Ciudad Universitaria. Demuestra tu habilidad en uno de los recintos emblemáticos de la ciudad. Esta competencia tendrá un costo de $80 MXN Pumacubo CDMX 2026 es una competencial oficial de la WCA, por lo cual todos los competidores deben conocer y cumplir con el [reglamento oficial.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing y el equipo organizador con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen. **English** Welcome to Pumacubo CDMX 2026! Be part of the first cube competition held in Ciudad Universitaria. Show off your skills in one of the most iconic venues in the city. This competition will have a cost of $80 MXN. Pumacubo CDMX 2026 is an official WCA competition, therefore all competitors must know and comply with the [official regulations.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/about/) **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing and the organization team for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image.

venue.name: Taberna Dei Ooskampus
venue.details: Side entrance next to parking lot. Follow the signs

items.information: [CubingZA](https://cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce the first Polokwane competition of 2024! This competition has a focus on holding popular events to give newer competitors an easy oppurtunity to start competing with the rest of the South African cubing community. The competition is open to **anyone** who knows how to solve a cube! Whether you take 20 seconds or 5 minutes to solve the 3x3 we will be happy to have you! ## Newcomers and returners This competition will recognise both a newcomer and experienced competitor podium across all the events. Be sure to stick around for the chance to meet and compete with other cubers! ##### ALL NEW COMPETITORS If this is your first time competing, or the first time your child or ward is competing, please ensure to bring with ID (card, book, passport, birth certificate) so that we can verify that the name is spelled correctly, the Date of Birth is correct, and the Nationality is correct. Please also ensure you have all the puzzles you need to compete - we do not supply puzzles for competitors. You are welcome to ask other competitors if you can borrow their puzzle for a certain event, but there is no guarantee. If you need a puzzle before the competition, check out www.speedcubes.co.za, www.cubeco.co.za, or https://cubestuff.co.za/ to order your puzzles before the comp. ## Volunteers We will require volunteers to support with running, judging and scrambling on the day. We will demonstrate the process for these duties during the new competitor tutorial, and encourage everyone to get involved. You also do not have to be a competitor to volunteer! If you are a parent, family member, or friend of a competitor, please do not hesitate to volunteer if you would like to help the competition run smoothly. ## About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch.](https://cubingza.org/contact) We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.

items.name: Qualifying in Kirstenhof 2024
items.information: [CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce a new Cape Town competition for 2024. This competition is designed as a warmup/rankings qualifier for the [African Championships] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksWCAAfricanChampionship2024) that is coming up in September, so we will have plenty of events and plenty of rounds. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make payment by buying a ticket. Please see **Registration Requirements** below." ​ ## CHANGES TO THE FORMAT ​ We are wanting to maximise the opportunities for all the cubers in our community and as a result we have decided to make the qualifying criteria for second rounds and finals to be much more achievable. Our goal is to have more people competing in more rounds of solving!! ​ ### SPECTATORS ​ Competitors are welcome to bring 2 spectators with them. Please let us know if you need to accommodate more spectators. ​ ### VOLUNTEERING ​ Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be allocated prior to the event and explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ​ ### LUCKY DRAW ​ During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Sunday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store. ​

items.information: Quinnipiac University will host its first official WCA competition this September! We are planning a competition with a relaxed but engaging and social atmosphere, that will hopefully give the Connecticut cubing community a chance to connect. The theme of this competition is breadth rather than depth. Our events will sample a variety of puzzle categories, from larger cubes (4x4) and different solving approaches (One-Handed, Blindfolded, Fewest Moves), to puzzles of different shapes (Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1). All events except the traditional 3x3 speedsolve will be single rounds; Fewest Moves in particular will consist of **one** hour-long attempt. Family, friends, and guests are welcome, but we ask competitors to let us know the number of people attending on their registration forms. The parking lot in front of the venue should be free of charge, but there are no guarantees if that particular lot reaches capacity. We look forward to seeing you in September!

items.name: Rahn Education Leipzig 2023
items.information: **Deutsch** Wir laden euch herzlich ein zur ersten Competition in **Leipzig** in der Geschichte der WCA. Nach über 12 Jahren findet endlich wieder eine Competition in Sachsen statt und wir, das Orga-Team freuen uns auf euer zahlreiches Erscheinen. Euch erwartet eine schöne Venue in perfekter zentraler Lage in Leipzig und ein motiviertes Orga-Team. Lasst uns gemeinsam dafür sorgen, dass die Competition **Rahn Education Leipzig** ein traditionelles Event in der WCA wird. **Bitte lies dir alle Tabs sorgfältig durch, damit du mit dem Ablaufplan und allen Modalitäten vertraut bist.** **English** We cordially invite you to the first competition in **Leipzig** in the history of the WCA. After more than 12 years, there is finally a competition in Saxony and we, the organizing team, are looking forward to your numerous appearances. You can expect a beautiful venue in a perfect central location in Leipzig and a motivated organizational team. Let's work together to ensure that the **Rahn Education Leipzig** competition becomes a traditional event in the WCA. **Please read all tabs carefully so you are familiar with the schedule and all modalities.**

We, the organizing team, look forward to seeing you in large numbers. You can expect a beautiful venue in a perfect central location in Leipzig, great prices, food, a motivated organization team and much more. **Please read all tabs carefully so you are familiar with the schedule and all modalities.**

items.name: Rahn Education Open 2025
items.information: **Deutsch** Herzlich Willkommen zur **Rahn Education Open 2025** in Leipzig Nach den ersten beiden Competitions 2023 und 2024 sowie den Rubik's German Nationals 2024 können wir **Leipzig** nun zu einem etablierten Cubing-Standort zählen. Wir, das Orga-Team, freuen uns auf euer zahlreiches Erscheinen. Euch erwartet wieder eine schöne Venue in perfekter zentraler Lage in Leipzig, ein motiviertes Orga-Team und vieles mehr. Diese Ausgabe der **Rahn Education Open** im Rahmen des offiziellen WCA Newcomer Month richtet sich an neue und unerfahrene Cuber. Bei der Anmeldung werden deshalb 43,75% der Plätze für neue Teilnehmende reserviert. Als neue Teilnehmende gelten Teilnehmende ohne WCA-ID oder mit einer WCA-ID aus dem Jahr 2025. Wiederkehrende Teilnehmende haben eine WCA-ID, die aus dem Jahr 2024 oder früher stammt. Alle Teilnehmenden müssen weiterhin alle Registrierungsanforderungen erfüllen, damit ihre Registrierung als vollständig gilt. Weitere Informationen zur Annahme der Anmeldungen findet ihr im Tab "Newcomer Month". **Bitte lies dir alle Tabs sorgfältig durch, damit du mit dem Ablaufplan und allen Modalitäten vertraut bist.** **English** Welcome to the **Rahn Education Open 2025** in Leipzig After the first two competitions in 2023 and 2024 and the Rubik's German Nationals 2024, we can now count **Leipzig** as an established cubing location. We, the organizing team, are looking forward to your numerous appearances. Once again, you can expect a beautiful venue in a perfect central location in Leipzig, a motivated organizing team and much more. This edition of the **Rahn Education Open** as part of the official WCA Newcomer Month is aimed at new and inexperienced cubers. When registering, 43.75% of the places will therefore be reserved for new participants. Participants without a WCA ID or with a WCA ID from the year 2025 are considered new participants. Returning participants have a WCA ID from the year 2024 or earlier. All participants must continue to fulfill all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. You can find more information on how registrations are accepted in the “Newcomer Month” tab. **Please read all tabs carefully so you are familiar with the schedule and all modalities.**

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. items.information: Chignahuapan, *pueblo mágico*, es el principal productor de esferas en todo el país, bello por folklor y sus paisajes naturales como la laguna de Chignahuapan, las cascadas de Quetzalapan, las aguas termales y sus bosques. Han pasado casi 8 años desde el primer Reto Chignahuapan, es hora de traer uno nuevo y no hay otra mejor manera que con un gran torneo. Este torneo es posible gracias al staff del ***Puebla Rubik’s Team*** y al ***Gobierno municipal de Chignahuapan.*** ![](https://i.imgur.com/17KskVW.jpg) Chignahuapan, *pueblo magico*, is the main manufacturer of Christmas spheres in Mexico. Chignahuapan is beautiful because its folklore and its natural landscapes are amazing. 8 years have passed since the first *Reto Chignahuapan*, it's time to bring a new one but in shape of 2019 This tournament is supported to ***Puebla Rubik's Team*** staff and ***Chignahuapan municipal government***

items.information: Diese Ausgabe der Rhein-Neckar-Competition **im Rahmen des offiziellen WCA Newcomer Month** richtet sich insbesondere an neue und unerfahrene Cuber, aber auch alle anderen Cuber sind herzlich willkommen. Wir freuen uns auf euch! Bei der Anmeldung werden 35% der Plätze für neue Teilnehmende reserviert. Als neue Teilnehmende gelten Teilnehmer:innen ohne WCA-ID oder mit einer WCA-ID aus dem Jahr 2024. Wiederkehrende Teilnehmende haben eine WCA-ID, die aus dem Jahr 2023 oder früher stammt. Alle Teilnehmenden müssen weiterhin alle Registrierungsanforderungen erfüllen, damit ihre Registrierung als vollständig gilt. Weitere Informationen zur Annahme der Anmeldungen findet ihr im Tab "Newcomer Month". This edition of the Rhein-Neckar competitions is participating **in the official WCA Newcomer Month** and is especially directed towards new and inexperienced competitors. Of course every other cuber is welcome as well - we are looking forward to seeing all of you there! The registration process will reserve 35% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Further information on the acceptance of registrations can be found in the tab "Newcomer Month". ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc0phIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--757a22c30b75dcff95194ffd68cb7c180c714d6e/WCA%20Newcomer%20Month%20LOGO_A1.jpg)

items.information: As per BC's recently announced [Proof of Vaccination Requirement](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/covid-19/vaccine/proof), All attendees are required to have **FULL vaccination (2 doses)** by the event date otherwise, you will NOT be allowed to enter the venue. Please **review ALL of the tabs listed on this website**. This is a priority. **Even if you are a seasoned competitor, COVID-19 has created some new shifts** and there are things to be particularly attentive to. Note that this is a **one of a pair of series competitions**. Series competitions (formerly known as twin competitions) are relatively new to BC. Please see the Series Competiton Tab for more information. Take clear note especially of the Health and Safety Tab, containing our Risk Mitigation Plan. Note: **Spectators (max 1 per competitor)** can attend for free. Those aged 18+ are invited to consider not attending with a guest to help our venue capacity numbers as low as possible. **If you're not a competitor, nor the single guest of a competitor, then we ask you NOT to come.** Note: As the pandemic is an ever-evolving situation, there is of course the possibility that we will need to increase safety precautions or, in the worst case, cancel the competition. **Please be aware that changes may be needed.** Email will be sent out to registered competitors about significant changes. In the eventof cancellation we will do our best to provide full refunds to everyone.

items.name: River Hill Fall 2022
items.information: This is a series competition with [Crystal City Fall 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CrystalCityFall2022). You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for Crystal City Fall 2022, your registration for this competition will be rejected. **COVID-19 SAFETY INFORMATION:** All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of a negative test for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. A rapid test is acceptable proof for a negative result. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Tuesday, November 15th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. Along with a negative test document, a valid ID must be shown and checked at the registration desk on the day of the competition. Any proof sent electronically to the organizers and/or delegates prior to the competition will not be accepted. Competitors and guests are *strongly recommended* to wear masks during the day to help prevent spread and protect themselves from COVID-19. Additionally, competitors are *strongly recommended* to bring at most one guest. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- This competition is supported by CubingUSA. ![](https://cubingusa.org/static/img/cubingUSA_4.svg)

items.information: Varmt välkomna till Riverlake 2026! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information. **OBS:** Maximalt en gäst / medföljande per deltagare på grund av tävlingslokalens storlek. Ingen utomstående publik tillåten. -- A warm welcome to Riverlake 2026! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information. **N.B.:** Maximum one guest / accompanying person per competitors due to the size of the competition venue. items.name: Romandie Rookies 2025
items.information: ### WCA Newcomer Month ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjAzODksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--9f4703bb8694974000e48f846fd2d76ffa28f318/newcomer.jpg) [FR] C'est une compétition très accessible pour les débutants ! Tout le monde est le bienvenu mais si vous n'avez jamais participé à une compétition auparavant, c'est celle à laquelle vous devez vous inscrire ! Cette compétition fait partie du mois officiel des débutants WCA 2025. Le processus d'inscription réservera 50 % des places pour les nouveaux compétiteurs. Les nouveaux compétiteurs sont considérés comme n'ayant pas d'ID WCA ou ayant un ID WCA datant de 2025. Les anciens compétiteurs sont considérés comme ayant un ID WCA datant d'avant 2024. Les inscriptions seront acceptées selon les critères suivants : 50 % des places sont réservées aux nouveaux compétiteurs, et l'autre moitié est disponible pour les autres compétiteurs, selon le principe du premier arrivé, premier servi. Si les nouveaux compétiteurs s'inscrivent rapidement et remplissent plus de 50 % des places, les autres nouveaux compétiteurs seront acceptés en même temps que les anciens. Si les places réservées aux nouveaux compétiteurs ne sont pas toutes prises avant la clôture des inscriptions (deux semaines avant la compétition), les places restantes seront ouvertes pour tous. Cette compétition fait partie d'une série avec Romandie Doigts Rapides 2025. Vous ne pouvez vous inscrire et participer qu'à l'une de ces compétitions. [EN] This is a very beginner-friendly competition! Everyone is welcome but if you have never competed before this is the one to sign up for! This competition is part of the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID from 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. This competition is a series competition with Romandie Doigtes Rapides 2025. You may only register for and compete in one of these competitions.

items.information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RowlandHeightsFallA2026#76810-competitor-responsibilities) tab. items.name: Rubik's North America All-Stars 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa05zIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c3e44aec5cbb0ee93127339ad0d85620fe1e8c43/All-Star%202024%20Logo.png) ## Rubik's North America All-Stars 2024 [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/) and [CubingUSA](https://www.cubingusa.org/) are excited to team up with [Rubik's](https://rubiks.com) and [Spin Master](https://www.spinmaster.com) to bring speedcubing all-stars together for an official WCA competition at the Mall of America® in Bloomington, Minnesota! ## Qualification To qualify to register for this competition, you must have an official sub-7.00 3x3x3 average. This result must have occurred at a competition that took place on or before March 21, 2024. If you don't qualify for this competition, look for one of the many other opportunities to compete in the Midwest area, including [Minnesota Warm Up 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MinnesotaWarmUp2024) on July 13 and July 14, also being held at the Mall of America! We also invite you to watch Rubik's North America All-Stars 2024 via the livestream, or if you are in the area stop by the Mall of America® and watch it live! ## Spectators and Livestream We're thrilled to put competitive speedcubing on display via the Rubik's North America All-Stars 2024 livestream. See the Livestream tab for more details. The event will be open to in-person spectators who will be able to view this competition from mulitple levels of the Mall of America®, including on the jumbotron that will be projected in the Huntington Bank Rotunda. Reserved VIP seating will also be available for up to two guests for each competitor. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of the Rubik's North America All-Stars 2024 competition consent to their images being used by Midwest Cubing Association and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBakE3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fef34846d3c62170fea8a28a2f5b052616366ff3/Rubik-poster-1080x1080p-Final.jpg) ## Rubik's x Speedcubing Canada All-Stars 2023 [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/en) is excited to team up with [Rubik's](https://rubiks.com) and [Spin Master](https://www.spinmaster.com) to bring speedcubing all-stars together for an official WCA competition at Spin Master's HQ in the heart of downtown Toronto, Canada! ## Qualification To qualify to register for this competition, you must have an official sub-9.00 3x3x3 average. This result must have occurred at a competition that took place on or before August 1, 2023. If you don't qualify for this competition, look for one of the many other opportunities to compete in the Greater Toronto Area—including Ajax 3x3x3 [Morning](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Ajax333Morning2023), [Afternoon](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Ajax333Afternoon2023) or [Evening](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Ajax333Evening2023), taking place the day after All-Stars. We also invite you to watch Rubik's x Speedcubing Canada All-Stars 2023 via the livestream! ## Spectators and Livestream We're thrilled to put competitive speedcubing on display via the Rubik's x Speedcubing Canada All-Stars 2023 livestream. See the Livestream tab for more details. Competitors are permitted to bring two guests. Unfortunately, due to limited space in the competition venue, other in-person spectators are **not** permitted at Rubik's x Speedcubing Canada All-Stars 2023. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Rubik's UK Championship 2023
items.information: ## Welcome to Rubik's UK Championship 2023! ### This year's UK National Championship! #### Please read ALL tabs before registering as there is lots of information which will be new to you, even if you are an experienced competitor. ##### Spectators are welcome! Please read the information below, and the information in the [Guests, Spectators, and Media](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2023#32058-guests-spectators-and-media) tab. **Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Rubik's UK Championship 2023, you'll receive a Rubik's UK Championship 2023 t-shirt as a memento! **Please fill in your registration comment with your t-shirt size.** **Guests:** Guests will **only** be permitted to attend by paying a **£5** fee **at the competition**. Competitors will receive lanyards, and their guests and spectators will receive wristbands, which are to be worn throughout the weekend for security reasons. **This includes parents/guardians of competitors.** The fee must be paid at the competition and cannot be prepaid beforehand. The guest field in the registration form is for informational purposes only; the fee must be paid at the competition. We accept cash or card payments. **Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2023#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by *9th October 2023*, you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. There are no qualifications in 3x3, 2x2, Pyraminx, or Skewb, so **newcomers will be able to compete in these events only**. **Final Round Advancements:** For all events with more than one round, we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1 - 6 UK competitors; 3x3 - 8 UK competitors. 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded has a Top 16 qualification requirement, similarly this must contain at least 6 UK competitors. **Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Rubik's UK Championship FMC 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionshipFMC2023). The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Rubik's UK Championship 2023. **Please Note:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa0pMIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bcff7b5bdf0f0846e919c48b2fc43d8a54c9d36f/UKC%202023%20LOGO%20-%20RGB%20(FOR%20SCREENS)%20-%20(TRANSPARENT)%20-%20(WITH%20SPONSORSHIP).png)

Базовый взнос с возможностью участия в любом количестве дисциплин составляет 3500 тенге, при регистрации на месте - 4000 тенге. Пәндердің кез келген санына қатысу ақысы - 3500 теңге, өткізілу орынында тіркелген кезде - 4000 теңге. Кез келген бір пәнге қатысу ақысы - 1000 теңге, өткізілу орынында тіркелген кезде - 1500 теңге. The base registration fee for any number of events is 3500 tenge. It's 4000 tenge when registering on the spot. If you're participating in 1 event only, the registration fee is 1000 tenge. It will be 1500 tenge when registering on the spot. Rudny Open is going to be the first competition organized by the QBERS team.

organisers.name: [{Eduardo Arturo Palacios Merino}{mailto:eduardofleit47@gmail.com}] [{Gonzalo Galíndez Rangel}{mailto:gonzalo_galindezr@outlook.com}] [{Omar Reyes Martínez}{mailto:oreyesm0621@gmail.com}]

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTYwNTgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--3aa05b1024ee2e9271b7b0bd5d799771742bd090/IZCALLI%201%202%203%20(2).png) #### BIENVENIDOS A LA PRIMER PARADA DE LA RUTA CUBERA 2025, IZCALLI CLÁSICO Después de 6 años México regresa a tener una ruta cubera, por 3 ciudadades alrededor del país, siendo la primera Cuautitlán Izcalli en el Estado de México, con nuestro querido torneo Clásico! Habrá sorpresas para todos aquellos que completen la Ruta Cubera 2025, así que no dejes que se te vaya la primer parada, prepara tus mejores 3x3 y 2x2, te esperamos en Izcalli!. Un agradecimiento especial a las FES-Cuautitlán UNAM por las facilidades y apoyo para realizar este evento, y al Team Izcalli por el compromiso para poderlo llevar a cabo. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el reglamento de la WCA antes de la competencia.[](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/). #### WELCOME TO THE FIRST STOP OF THE CUBER ROUTE 2025, IZCALLI CLASICO After 6 years, Mexico returns to have a cuba route, through 3 cities around the country, the first being Cuautitlán Izcalli in the State of Mexico, with our beloved Classic tournament! There will be surprises for all those who complete the Cuber 2025 Route, so don't let the first stop pass you by, prepare your best 3x3 and 2x2, we are waiting for you in Izcalli! We thank the FES-Cuautitlán UNAM for the facilities and support to hold this event and to the izcalli team for the commitment to be able to carry it out. This competition is recognized as an official competition of the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the WCA regulations before the competition. [](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/)
